# OpenProgram 0.7.1 Release Notes

OpenProgram 0.7.1 expands the built-in browser release with multi-page Computer Use, browser downloads and page tools, Memory and Agent management, workflow execution, and a simplified installation and repository layout. It also removes bundled default skills without removing the user-extensible Skill system.

## 🐞 Bug fixes

- Prevented an OpenProgram wheel installed inside an unrelated Git repository from being misidentified as a source checkout.
- Fixed session follow-up publication, custom provider endpoint normalization, chat timestamps, context caching and statistics, migrated source paths, and release staging consistency.

## ✨ New features

- Unified Program source browsing and local Agent management actions.
- Added multi-backend, multi-page Computer Use with exact page bindings, cross-window and grouped-page inventory, and persistent agent cursor state.
- Added browser downloads, page tools, print-to-PDF, popup-tab handling, cancellable profile import, and pointer-hover bookmark folder switching.
- Added runtime Memory settings, revised Memory management surfaces, and scheduler-to-memory linkage.
- Added the complete local Agent configuration workspace.
- Added workflow project, dependency, package, and execution support.

## 🚀 Improvements

- Kept the Agent Core and Python SDK at the root `openprogram/` package while organizing Web, Desktop, Server, and CLI application code under `apps/`.
- Unified Web, Desktop, and Ink CLI dependency installation under one root npm workspace and lock file.
- Consolidated release scripts and expanded packaged-runtime, installation, and repository verification.
- Removed the bundled `agentic-programming`, `commit-push-pr`, `distill`, and `self-update` skills. Product workflows belong to Programs. Skills remain available from remote cache, plugins, `~/.openprogram/skills/`, and the current project's `skills/` directory.

## 📦 Download and installation

- **macOS**
  - **Package installation**
    - Apple Silicon: download `OpenProgram-0.7.1-mac-arm64-unsigned.dmg` or `OpenProgram-0.7.1-mac-arm64-unsigned.zip`.
    - Intel: download `OpenProgram-0.7.1-mac-x64-unsigned.dmg` or `OpenProgram-0.7.1-mac-x64-unsigned.zip`.
  - **Command-line installation**
    - Run `curl -fsSL https://openprogram.io/install | sh`.
  - **Development installation**
    - Follow the development installation guide for source editing and testing.
  - macOS package and command-line installations share the same complete runtime and browser backend. Electron multi-Pane support and the built-in Browser Pane are available only in the macOS Desktop App.
- **Linux**
  - **Command-line / Server installation**
    - Run `curl -fsSL https://openprogram.io/install | sh`.
  - **Development installation**
    - Follow the development installation guide for source editing and testing.

## 🔄 Upgrade guide

- Desktop users can install the matching DMG and replace the existing application.
- CLI and Server users can run `openprogram upgrade` or repeat the public installation command.
- User data under `~/.openprogram` is preserved.

The release also includes Python wheel and source-distribution artifacts, complete managed runtimes for supported macOS and Linux architectures, checksums, and a machine-readable release manifest.
